mobbin:337a0dfd-6591-4af6-97b3-397dcc6ea.summary: From a place page, the user enters the 360° street view and moves with arrows on the ground. A split screen adds a map whose marker shows which way they face, and older dates and recent photos are one tap away.
steps: Place card: Immersive and Street View entry
Advance along street; map stays synced
Map strip with Latest photos and dates
steal: The 360° view splits with a flat map whose marker points the way you face (screens 4 to 5). That could become a room layout next to 360° playback.
Arrows on the ground move between capture points without leaving the 360° view (screens 2 to 3).
'See more dates' and 'Latest photos' switch to another capture date or to still photos of the same place without leaving 360° (screens 3 and 6).
There are two ways in: a Street View marker on the map and an Immersive View card among the photos (screen 1).
avoid: Roaming freely through outdoor panoramas is not the same as moving through a fixed 360° recording of a sim room; do not make endless walking the main debrief control.
mobbin:337a0dfd-6591-4af6-97b3-397dcc6ea.fit: Debrief and review: a fallback for camera views, since Tesla showed no multi-camera switching. A map that shows your direction next to the 360° view is the idea to borrow for 360° review beside SRV playback.
